The Group transfers control of a good or service over time and therefore satisfies a performance obligation and recognises revenue over a period of time if one of the following criteria is met: (a) the customer simultaneously consumes the benefit of the company’s performance or (b) the customer controls the asset as it is being created/enhanced by the company’s performance or (c) there is no alternative use of the asset and the company has either explicit or implicit right of payment considering legal precedents.
